- **Step implement-bootstrap emergency-bypass-log — /implement --emergency preflight bypassed (exit 0)**:
  ```
BYPASS kind=missing-designed-prefix issue=4996
BYPASS kind=missing-plan issue=4996
  ```

- **Step 2 (ambiguity)**: Issue #4996 offered three approaches for the primary fix (snapshot forensics into plan-review/round-N/, round-stamped filenames, or a per-round --review-tmpdir) plus an open question on whether aggregator forensics should live under plan-review/round-N/.
  **A**: Chose the per-round snapshot into plan-review/round-N/ plus a round-aware committed pointer (new aggregator --round-dir). Most consistent with how reviewer forensics already land in plan-review/round-N/, matches the committed-log structure and docs/run-logs-required-files.tsv round-*/aggregator-validate.stderr, and avoids the --allow-findings-outside-tmpdir / scope-anchor interactions a relocated --review-tmpdir would introduce. Snapshot is gated on aggregator failure so clean runs add no committed bytes.
- **findings aggregator**: merged output failed validation; leaving <TMPDIR>/round-1/findings.md unchanged. See round-1/aggregator-validate.stderr in the committed run log.
- **Step 7a — session-transcript status=captured:** session transcript was written; commit deferred to caller.
